svg.aria-label: How to write ۴ ۵ ۶: 3 letters, ۴, ۵, ۶, one after another
svg.title: Writing ۴ ۵ ۶
svg.desc: 3 letters written one after another: ۴, ۵, ۶ (perso-arabic). Each letter has its own group of frames; frame N of a group shows movements 1 to N of that letter, the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoNaskhArabic-Static.ttf. Each letter is drawn at its own scale from its own cited stroke order, so the strip does not show how large the letters are next to each other, how far apart they sit, or any join between them. Stroke order: ۴: POH-Db, Persian Online Handwriting Database (SLT Lab, Amirkabir University of Technology; github.com/SLTLabAUT/POH-Db at commit 018b039, Writepads/NumberGroup; AGPL-3.0, facts only): 465 aligned samples of ۴ from 30 native writers; one stroke in 462 (99%); starts at the top right in 315 (68%) and at the top centre in 134 (29%) <https://github.com/SLTLabAUT/POH-Db/tree/018b039c0f80d84da16fc9c0f7f629c746a5b3c8/Writepads/NumberGroup>; ۵: POH-Db, Persian Online Handwriting Database (SLT Lab, Amirkabir University of Technology; github.com/SLTLabAUT/POH-Db at commit 018b039, Writepads/NumberGroup; AGPL-3.0, facts only): 493 aligned samples of ۵ from 29 native writers; one stroke in 491 (100%); starts in the top third in 487 (99%; top left 320, 65%; top centre 145, 29%) <https://github.com/SLTLabAUT/POH-Db/tree/018b039c0f80d84da16fc9c0f7f629c746a5b3c8/Writepads/NumberGroup>; ۶: POH-Db, Persian Online Handwriting Database (SLT Lab, Amirkabir University of Technology; github.com/SLTLabAUT/POH-Db at commit 018b039, Writepads/NumberGroup; AGPL-3.0, facts only): 471 aligned samples of ۶ from 30 native writers; one stroke in 469 (100%); starts in the top third in 469 (100%; top left 314, 67%; top centre 135, 29%) <https://github.com/SLTLabAUT/POH-Db/tree/018b039c0f80d84da16fc9c0f7f629c746a5b3c8/Writepads/NumberGroup>. Source notes on variation: ۴: Counted for this record from POH-Db's NumberGroup writepads: lines of Persian numbers that native writers wrote on FarsiHandwriting.ir with a pen, a finger or a stylus (112 writepads by 30 writers; the mouse writepads were left out), recorded as InkML, where each trace is one pen-down stroke. Each line was split into characters by horizontal overlap; of the 1,046 lines whose character count matched their label, the 1,005 whose characters ran left to right were used (which also shows that the numbers are written left to right). Zones are thirds of each character's box, and the split is heuristic, so the shares are approximate. Of 465 samples of ۴, 462 (99%) are one stroke. 315 (68%) start at the top right and 134 (29%) at the top centre, on the upper curl. Of the 462 one-stroke samples, 326 (71%) reach the middle of the right side and then come back to the left third, the trip out along the lower arm and back; 374 (81%) reach the top left after leaving the start; and 460 (100%) end in the bottom third: the stem comes last, downward. POH-Db is licensed AGPL-3.0, so only these counts and shares are taken; no coordinate or trace is copied, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Naskh Arabic outline rather than to any sample. Handwriting varies by writer. ۵: Counted for this record from POH-Db's NumberGroup writepads: lines of Persian numbers that native writers wrote on FarsiHandwriting.ir with a pen, a finger or a stylus (112 writepads by 30 writers; the mouse writepads were left out), recorded as InkML, where each trace is one pen-down stroke. Each line was split into characters by horizontal overlap; of the 1,046 lines whose character count matched their label, the 1,005 whose characters ran left to right were used (which also shows that the numbers are written left to right). Zones are thirds of each character's box, and the split is heuristic, so the shares are approximate. Of 493 samples of ۵, 491 (100%) are one stroke. 487 (99%) start in the top third, at the loop's point (top left 320, 65%; top centre 145, 29%), and 385 (78%) first move down and to the right. Of the 491 one-stroke samples, 468 (95%) are moving leftward at their lowest point, so the pen goes down the right side first and comes back up the left, and 356 (73%) end in the top third again, closing the loop where it began. POH-Db is licensed AGPL-3.0, so only these counts and shares are taken; no coordinate or trace is copied, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Naskh Arabic outline rather than to any sample. Handwriting varies by writer. ۶: Counted for this record from POH-Db's NumberGroup writepads: lines of Persian numbers that native writers wrote on FarsiHandwriting.ir with a pen, a finger or a stylus (112 writepads by 30 writers; the mouse writepads were left out), recorded as InkML, where each trace is one pen-down stroke. Each line was split into characters by horizontal overlap; of the 1,046 lines whose character count matched their label, the 1,005 whose characters ran left to right were used (which also shows that the numbers are written left to right). Zones are thirds of each character's box, and the split is heuristic, so the shares are approximate. Of 471 samples of ۶, 469 (100%) are one stroke. 469 (100%) start in the top third (top left 314, 67%; top centre 135, 29%), and 304 (65%) first move down. Of the 469 one-stroke samples, 444 (95%) reach the upper right before they reach the bottom third, and 464 (99%) end in the bottom third: down the left, a swing up to the right, then the long slant down to the lower left. The printed curl of Noto Naskh reaches further right than most writers begin, so the path starts at the top centre, where 29% begin, and its first movement runs down and to the left rather than straight down; that keeps the printed curl traced. POH-Db is licensed AGPL-3.0, so only these counts and shares are taken; no coordinate or trace is copied, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Naskh Arabic outline rather than to any sample. Handwriting varies by writer.
svg.text: How it is written — 3 letters, one after another
Letter 1 of 3 — one unbroken stroke · 4 movements
Letter 2 of 3 — one unbroken stroke · 3 movements
Letter 3 of 3 — one unbroken stroke · 3 movements
Letter 1: stroke order after POH-Db, Persian Online Handwriting Database (SLT Lab, Amirkabir University of Technology; github.com/SLTLabAUT/POH-Db at commit 018b039,
Writepads/NumberGroup; AGPL-3.0, facts only): 465 aligned samples of ۴ from 30 native writers; one stroke in 462 (99%); starts at the top right in 315 (68%) and at the top centre in 134

Letter 3: stroke order after POH-Db, Persian Online Handwriting Database (SLT Lab, Amirkabir University of Technology; github.com/SLTLabAUT/POH-Db at commit 018b039,
Writepads/NumberGroup; AGPL-3.0, facts only): 471 aligned samples of ۶ from 30 native writers; one stroke in 469 (100%); starts in the top third in 469 (100%; top left 314, 67%; top
